source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I need a case which can fit all 3 boards and 18650 battery and has a cover with display cutout (1.5 or 2.9 display need to decide on that). Cover shouldn't have any mounts on it except display which should be possible to connect and pit the case on easily. All boards and lipo should have mounts on the base. I can send some pictures of current design. Also there is air intake where sensors are below and air out take on top. For the leds I will put semi transparent plexiglass stribe above them or we can nake some grid pattern so light can go through.

value_updates.cover_mounting_policy: No cover-mounted components except the display
value_updates.led_light_transmission: Semi-transparent plexiglass strip or a grid pattern
